author: koorby64
quote:
Best game I’ve ever played, period. An absolute masterclass in world design, storytelling and puzzles that keep you captivated from the first scene.

It takes the 1998 timeless classic and blasts it into the 21st century at 4K60FPS with such effortless ease on the Switch 2 that it sends a huge warning shot across the bow of AAA games on XBox and PS5 consoles 5x as powerful that struggle to achieve such a compelling experience with 10-30x the development budgets.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: koorby64
quote:
Sold my PS5 Pro a week before release because I knew user fallout would be huge. The good news is I made a £200 profit on my PS5.

This will likely be decomped before Xmas but in any case I will probably grab it on a Steam sale sometime in 2027 once the PC port has been debugged and I can run it at 60fps.

If there are positives I think it’s a technically triumph and makes a great immersive walking simulator.
